command: /entrypoint.sh couchbase-server & until curl -s http://localhost:8091/pools > /dev/null; do sleep 2; done; couchbase-cli cluster-init -c localhost --cluster-username Administrator --cluster-password "$MIRRORD_PARAM_PASSWORD" --services data,index,query --cluster-ramsize 512 --cluster-index-ramsize 256; couchbase-cli bucket-create -c localhost -u Administrator -p "$MIRRORD_PARAM_PASSWORD" --bucket sandbox --bucket-type couchbase --bucket-ramsize 256; wait
